raw: [name="Manfred"]So you mean to say that Hoederer has failed?
speaker: Manfred

speaker: Manfred
content: And he was in contact with another Sarkaz woman, aside from his longtime mercenary acquaintance?

content: Right. But she's... highly skilled at concealment, and moves too quickly.

content: I was anxious about getting too close. Couldn't shake the feeling she'd notice me with one wrong step.

speaker: Manfred
content: Wise choice. You wouldn't have made it back alive otherwise.

content: That said, I'm surprised the Confessarius let Babel's assassin go free. Was that an oversight, or their intent?

content: He's still marshaling the remaining mercenaries, and about to resume pursuing the escaped convicts.

speaker: Manfred
content: Have him return. Those convicts will not stay free forever.

speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: General?

speaker: Manfred
content: As you said, his wounds are no laughing matter.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]Forgive me, but why do you still trust Hoederer so much?
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Forgive me, but why do you still trust Hoederer so much?

raw: [name="Manfred"]I've had you with him this whole time.
speaker: Manfred
content: I've had you with him this whole time.

raw: [name="Manfred"]Correct me if I'm wrong, but you've never once reported any misdeeds from him.
speaker: Manfred
content: Correct me if I'm wrong, but you've never once reported any misdeeds from him.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]But he used to work for Babel!
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: But he used to work for Babel!

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]It was the mercenaries under his watch that screwed up, and it was his old friend that incited them! Don't you think it's too risky to keep him in such a key position, General?
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: It was the mercenaries under his watch that screwed up, and it was his old friend that incited them! Don't you think it's too risky to keep him in such a key position, General?

raw: [name="Manfred"]You've seen for yourself today. How does one Victorian regard another?
speaker: Manfred
content: You've seen for yourself today. How does one Victorian regard another?

speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Urgh...

raw: [name="Manfred"]And how much more difficult do you think it is for one Sarkaz to trust another?
speaker: Manfred
content: And how much more difficult do you think it is for one Sarkaz to trust another?

raw: [name="Manfred"]We've had everything stolen from us, been forced to grow accustomed to fighting each other for the right to survive.
speaker: Manfred
content: We've had everything stolen from us, been forced to grow accustomed to fighting each other for the right to survive.

raw: [name="Manfred"]And now, we've obtained a new opportunity.
speaker: Manfred
content: And now, we've obtained a new opportunity.

raw: [name="Manfred"]You tell me, do you want to go back to monitoring a possible Sarkaz spy, or will you accompany me in eliminating the remaining Victorian threats?
speaker: Manfred
content: You tell me, do you want to go back to monitoring a possible Sarkaz spy, or will you accompany me in eliminating the remaining Victorian threats?

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]General, we choose to go with you.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: General, we choose to go with you.

speaker: Feist
content: *pant*... *pant*... Did we shake them?

speaker: Amiya
content: We can't let our guards down yet, Mr. Feist.

speaker: Feist
content: I know... *huff*... I know.

speaker: Rockrock
content: ...Captain.

content: What is it?

content: Your face is splattered in blood.

speaker: Feist
content: Blood?! Hey, Bill... Bill?

speaker: Bill
content: Nrgh...

raw: [name="Feist"]...Oh, it's just my own blood. No need to panic, then.
speaker: Feist
content: ...Oh, it's just my own blood. No need to panic, then.

speaker: Feist
content: Come on, Bill, you could breathe a little louder! I don't want to have spent all this effort porting a dead man back.

speaker: Bill
content: You're always... hitting me... in the head...

raw: [name="Feist"]I hear you. You're the boss today.
speaker: Feist
content: I hear you. You're the boss today.

speaker: Feist
content: Hold on a little longer... we'll be right back home soon. Right? I'm not going blind, am I?

raw: [name="Feist"]Eugh, this blood from my forehead's getting in my eyes a little... Rockrock, eyes out. How much left to our target rendezvous?
speaker: Feist
content: Eugh, this blood from my forehead's getting in my eyes a little... Rockrock, eyes out. How much left to our target rendezvous?

raw: [name="Rockrock"]A little over 300 meters and we're there.
speaker: Rockrock
content: A little over 300 meters and we're there.

raw: [name="Feist"]It's Team 6 on guard here, right? I could really use a hand from them. Bill, old bud, you're getting harder to carry by the second.
speaker: Feist
content: It's Team 6 on guard here, right? I could really use a hand from them. Bill, old bud, you're getting harder to carry by the second.

speaker: Siege
content: ...How long have we gone without a signal from the surface team?

speaker: Indra
content: Didn't the Doctor say they'd only contact us after they reach that last RDV?

raw: [name="Siege"]No, I mean the Self-Salvation Corps, at the one before that.
speaker: Siege
content: No, I mean the Self-Salvation Corps, at the one before that.

speaker: Siege
content: We had an agreement that they'd keep us up to date with the surface situation every half hour.

raw: [name="Indra"]Shit, I wasn't tracking the time! How long's it been?
speaker: Indra
content: Shit, I wasn't tracking the time! How long's it been?

raw: [name="Siege"]...We need to go up and see.
speaker: Siege
content: ...We need to go up and see.

speaker: Indra
content: No!

raw: [name="Siege"]If the Sarkaz have already discovered our last rendezvous, then the Doctor's squad is in danger. You're clearly worried sick about Morgan and Dagda too.
speaker: Siege
content: If the Sarkaz have already discovered our last rendezvous, then the Doctor's squad is in danger. You're clearly worried sick about Morgan and Dagda too.

raw: [name="Indra"]Worst comes to worst, Vina, I go peek, and you stay here. Suppose somehow something's happened, you scarper further in...
speaker: Indra
content: Worst comes to worst, Vina, I go peek, and you stay here. Suppose somehow something's happened, you scarper further in...

speaker: Siege
content: Indra, I can't always keep cowering behind you all. First our mentor, then you and the Glasgow Gang, now the Doctor—

raw: [name="Siege"]—I've cowered for far too long, and I know it. Dagda wasn't talking nonsense. If you're always tucked away in the shadows, you gradually lose the courage to directly face the sun.
speaker: Siege
content: —I've cowered for far too long, and I know it. Dagda wasn't talking nonsense. If you're always tucked away in the shadows, you gradually lose the courage to directly face the sun.

raw: [name="Indra"]She's trying to nark you! You know what she's dying for? You, taking her to storm the Palace, and finding that what's-his-gent to do him in!
speaker: Indra
content: She's trying to nark you! You know what she's dying for? You, taking her to storm the Palace, and finding that what's-his-gent to do him in!

content: And you're itching to go back to the Glasgow Gang. Don't you understand her point of view?

speaker: Indra
content: I... Like hell I don't, but that's the bloody thing. I understand, and that's why...

raw: [name="Siege"]You're scared she'll end up killing herself, the way she rushes it.
speaker: Siege
content: You're scared she'll end up killing herself, the way she rushes it.

content: You can bloody imagine, can't you? She's got a death wish in my eyes, the way she acts!

content: She'll be willing to live for our sake... and the sake of so many, even if it comes with enormous pain.

raw: [name="Siege"]She's an outstanding knight, and a warrior of Victoria. She has everything in common with the countless others who struggle to live, and fight on for Victoria.

content: She's an outstanding knight, and a warrior of Victoria. She has everything in common with the countless others who struggle to live, and fight on for Victoria.

raw: [name="Siege"]And I... I have to fight with them. Not because I'm in some special position, but because we're all 'native' to this land.

content: And I... I have to fight with them. Not because I'm in some special position, but because we're all 'native' to this land.

speaker: Indra
